table3_zeroshot.tex: \caption{Zero-shot models under the same test (Kvasir-VQA-x1: polyp class; X-ray benchmarks: closed-ended questions answered yes). Image gain = accuracy with the image minus accuracy without the image of the same model, in percentage points (95\% image-bootstrap CI); $\Delta$ (necessity effect) under black fill and Gaussian blur with 95\% CI. Dual-fill: yes/no when the image gain is resolvable (CI lower bound above zero), otherwise n.r. (not resolvable: $\Delta$ not read). Affirmative rate: share of yes answers over all closed-ended questions (answer yes and no), with the intact image and without the image. $^{\ddagger}$Answers outside the short-answer format (accuracy 0 on the intact image).}
